name: Hyderabad Outer Ring Road

timeline.event: The full 158 km ring becomes operational
IRB Infrastructure takes over tolling and upkeep on a 30-year concession

history: The Nehru Outer Ring Road is a giant expressway circle around Hyderabad, built so that traffic can go around the city instead of through it. Work started in 2006, the first piece opened in 2008, and the whole 158 km loop was finished by 2018. It links the airport at Shamshabad with the IT hub at Gachibowli and the highways heading out of the city in every direction, and fast-growing suburbs have sprung up all along it.
facts: One of India's largest completed ring expressways, at 158 km around.
8 lanes wide and fully access-controlled, with a design speed of 120 km/h.
Connects Rajiv Gandhi International Airport at Shamshabad to the rest of the city.
In 2023 the toll rights were handed to IRB Infrastructure for 30 years for about ₹7,380 crore — one of India's biggest road tolling deals.
Built by the Hyderabad Growth Corridor Ltd, a company set up by the city's development authority HMDA.
